title: Fix admin panel button visibility in production

requirements.summary: Debug and fix the admin button not appearing in the Navbar component on the deployed web version
acceptanceCriteria: Admin button is visible in the header navigation when logged in as an admin user
Admin button correctly links to the admin panel
Admin button is hidden for non-admin users
Button displays consistently across desktop and mobile viewports

file_operations.description: Debug and fix the admin button visibility logic. Verify that the useCallerRole hook is properly integrated and that the isAdmin state correctly reflects the backend admin status. Ensure the admin link is rendered in both desktop and mobile navigation when isAdmin is true. Add console logging during development to track the isAdmin state and loading conditions. Verify the Link component correctly navigates to /admin when clicked.

Debug and verify the useCallerRole hook implementation. Ensure the query properly waits for both actor initialization and authentication state. Verify the 5-minute staleTime is appropriate for production use. Add error boundary handling for failed admin status checks. Ensure the hook returns consistent loading states that prevent premature rendering decisions in the Navbar. Consider adding retry logic for transient network failures in production environments.

requirements.summary: Verify that the useCallerRole hook correctly identifies admin users in the production environment
acceptanceCriteria: useCallerRole hook successfully fetches admin status from backend
Hook handles loading and error states appropriately
Admin status is cached correctly with 5-minute TTL
Hook works consistently in development and production environments

file_operations.description: Verify the isCallerAdmin backend method is called correctly with proper actor instance. Ensure the enabled flag properly gates the query until actor and authentication are ready. Verify the query returns consistent results across page refreshes and navigation. Add fallback handling for edge cases where the backend call might fail silently. Ensure the 5-minute cache invalidation works correctly and doesn't cause stale admin status in production.

Verify the actor initialization timing and ensure it completes before dependent hooks like useCallerRole execute queries. Check that identity changes properly trigger actor recreation and dependent query invalidation. Ensure the isFetching state accurately reflects actor readiness. Verify that the backend canister ID and authentication flow work correctly in production deployment environments.
